title: Visit to the Alhambra.
text: The Alhambra is a must in Granada, it is an impressive place, but the best part was how Antonio, our guide, immersed us in the history of the place, making the visit beautiful and very entertaining and educational.
author: natim10

title: Guide disappointment. Alberto Moreno
text: A tremendous discovery of this magical place thanks to our guide Alberto Moreno who accompanied us for 4 hours to share his passion for his country, particularly the Alhambra.
author: fran_oismK5343LD

title: Highly recommended activity, great level of the guide
text:
The visit has been excellent, due to the beauty of the Alhambra, because of it. In how organized it was and to a greater extent due to the excellent guide, Marta, who accompanied us on the visit.
Marta has been a perfect example of knowledge, friendliness, and telling anecdotes perfectly related to each moment of the visit.
A visit that you cannot miss.
author: Eduardo F

title: Excellent visit with Ramon
text: We are 5 Canarians and we are delighted with the visit that our guide Ramón has given us. He has explained everything in detail and with a perfect pace to facilitate understanding. Fully recommended.

title: A must-see visit and an unforgettable moment
